fields.Szenariobeschreibung: All material flows that contribute to more than 1 % of the total mass, energy, or environmental impact of the system have been considered in the LCA, and all datasets chosen for the modules A1-A3 refer to the Rest-of-the-World, GLO or Europe.   Rittal GmbH & Co. KG delivers its product to different countries, so the calculation of transport to construction site (A4) was done by taking the average distance, weighted by the proportion of product shipped to each country. For module A4, a data set for a non-specific truck was used. Considering the optimum working conditions of the product for cooling demands and product?s service life (10 years), product?s energy use (module B6) is determined. European electricity grid mix is considered. The numbers for this are calculated based on the following formula: Total energy consumption in kWh = Electricity consumption in kWh × (Operating hours / day) × (Operating days / year) x RSL  Where, based on experience and internal tests, the cooling unit will be used for 10 years mainly in industrial halls for 6 hours a day, 5 days a week. During the use phase (B1) carbon dioxide emissions due to refrigerant leakage are 0 % because the unit is hermetically sealed. It does not need to be refilled with refrigerant. If a leak does occurs, the unit will not be operational and must be serviced.  For the end-of-life, waste scenarios from the Dutch Nationale Milieudatabase (NMD) waste scenarios were used.
